title: Spec 014 SQL Run Reader Row Cardinality

phases.objective: Prove zero, one, or multiple durable run rows before returning a run instead of selecting the first SQL candidate.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Node process invoking the canonical SQL run-reader suite and focused cardinality regression
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Zero rows return not found, one row is normalized only after uniqueness proof, and multiple rows fail closed with STORAGE_SQL_RUN_READER_ROW_AMBIGUOUS.
steps: Normalize the SQL driver response into one bounded row collection.
Reject more than one row with the existing typed ambiguity error.
Keep the result null unless exactly one row is proven.
Destructure and normalize the sole proven row.
Run the complete SQL run-reader test and focused source-order regression.
assertions: No direct index-zero SQL candidate selection remains in readRun.
The existing ambiguity error and connection-release behavior remain fail closed.
The reader remains unmounted, read-only, non-provider, and non-production.
No schema, migration, live database, route, worker, deployment, main, or Production authority changes occur.

phases.objective: The repair changes only an unmounted read-only repository component.
Cardinality rejection is deterministic and introduces no retry state.
No live database or provider canary is introduced.
The change grants no deployment, migration, provider, or Production authority.
